{
  "test_name": "LedgerIssue2234Tests",
  "test_code": "using System;\nusing System.Collections.Generic;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing FluentAssertions;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator.Analyzers;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Diagnostics;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\n\npublic class LedgerIssue2234Tests\n{\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task AnalyzerReportsDiagnosticsWhenSuppressSourceGenerationIsTrue()\n    {\n        string testSource = \"\"\"\nusing MessagePack;\n\nnamespace TempProject\n{\n    [MessagePackObject(SuppressSourceGeneration = true)]\n    public class MyObject\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public int ValidProperty { get; set; }\n\n        public int MissingKeyProperty { get; set; }\n    }\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> frameworkRefs = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        IEnumerable<MetadataReference> references = frameworkRefs.Concat(ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack));\n\n        SyntaxTree syntaxTree = CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(testSource, new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest));\n        CSharpCompilation compilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"TestAssembly\",\n            new[] { syntaxTree },\n            references,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        compilation.GetDiagnostics()\n            .Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error)\n            .Should().BeEmpty();\n\n        ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> analyzerDiagnostics = await compilation\n            .WithAnalyzers(ImmutableArray.Create<DiagnosticAnalyzer>(new MsgPack00xMessagePackAnalyzer()))\n            .GetAnalyzerDiagnosticsAsync();\n\n        analyzerDiagnostics.Should().NotContain(d => d.Id == \"AD0001\");\n        analyzerDiagnostics.Should().Contain(d => d.Id == \"MsgPack004\");\n    }\n}\n"
}
